title: Choose the visual world for JEV
question: Choose the world that should govern the live command canvas, all 15 schema objects, and the optional JEV Inspector.

options.label: Composing Stick
options.lineage: movable type, composing sticks, proof galleys, and correction marks
options.thesis: The typed sentence is fitted into a precise interactive object as if words were locking into a composing rail.
options.viewport: One continuous composing rail holds the active command and the fitted schema slugs, while a narrow proof margin explains JEV's decision.
options.risk: The print lineage becomes costume if the interface loses the speed and precision of a contemporary instrument.

raised.raise: The command-to-object transition propagates through every linked field as one continuous structural transformation.
The Inspector shows probability trend and switching margin, not only a static winning score.
A persistent proof margin carries provenance, provider, generation, and correction history without enclosing the primary work.

options.label: Signal Routing Bench
options.lineage: signal analyzers, patch fields, calibrated traces, and live routing desks
options.thesis: The command is a live signal that routes into the correct interactive module while its classification remains measurable.
options.viewport: A visible trace enters the active command plane and locks into a conversion object, with the Inspector arranged as a calibrated signal stack.
options.risk: This is the most naturally familiar direction for a developer tool and can become generic observability UI if the routing ritual is weakened.

options.label: Deployable Fold Field
options.lineage: Miura-fold deployable sheets and linked crease geometry
options.thesis: A compact command packet unfolds in one motion into the complete selected object and its supporting evidence.
options.viewport: The Color schema deploys across linked cells while the Inspector occupies a connected fold column and recent candidates remain compact strips.
options.case: The transformation mechanism is exceptionally clear and memorable, but dense text editing and long-lived history fit the fold topology less naturally.
options.risk: The crease system can consume attention and layout flexibility when every one of the 15 schemas needs a different information density.

options.label: Night Instrument Cross-Check
options.lineage: a small aircraft's luminous six-pack in night flight
options.thesis: Each classifier truth becomes a trusted instrument in a practiced cross-check.
options.viewport: The selected object dominates while schema confidence and latency read as a fixed constellation of trusted instruments.
options.case: The Inspector becomes excellent, but the command's transformation into many different object types feels subordinate to monitoring.
options.risk: A cockpit metaphor overstates operational danger for a local prototype.
options.kept: Every diagnostic should show trend as well as current value.

options.label: Living Lexicon
options.lineage: a nineteenth-century lexicon with shoulder notes and bordered color plates
options.thesis: Each intent becomes a precise entry whose evidence and corrections remain visible in the margin.
options.viewport: The active object is one entry, recent objects form the reading measure, and the Inspector becomes a shoulder apparatus.
options.case: It carries provenance and heterogeneous history beautifully, but live morphing and direct manipulation feel slower than the product promise.
options.risk: Dense editorial composition can turn a fast command surface into a reading experience.
options.kept: Give provenance and correction history a stable shoulder margin.

canonCard.label: Polished AI Command Bar
canonCard.thesis: A centered rounded command card morphs into clean form cards with a conventional developer Inspector.
canonCard.viewport: A familiar SaaS command card sits in the center, recent objects stack below, and the Inspector opens as a standard right drawer.
canonCard.risk: Clear and credible, but indistinguishable from the category by design.
